# Tree Species Map (treecolors.botanisense.app)

Interactive map of street and park trees across North America, run by BotaniSense.
Each mapped point is one real tree; clicking it shows the species, a botanical
illustration, Wikipedia photos and the original inventory record.

## What the map contains

- 6,593,272 individual trees in 37 cities across the United States and Canada
- 3,070 distinct species names (1,780 normalized keys); 298 have an AI-generated botanical plate
- One PMTiles vector tileset (`/trees.pmtiles`), no per-city selector

Cities: Arlington County VA, Austin TX, Baltimore MD, Berkeley CA, Boston MA, Calgary AB,
Burlingame CA, Concord CA, Cupertino CA, Denver CO, Edmonton AB, Fremont CA, Hamilton ON,
Los Angeles CA, Los Gatos CA, Milpitas CA, Mississauga ON, Montgomery County MD, Montreal QC,
Mountain View CA, New York City NY, Ottawa ON, Palo Alto CA, Philadelphia PA, Portland OR, Richmond VA, San Diego CA, Santa Clara County CA,
San Francisco CA, San Jose CA, San Leandro CA, San Mateo CA, Seattle WA, Toronto ON, Vancouver BC,
Washington DC, Winnipeg MB.

## Colour legend

- Evergreen trees: green
- Ginkgo: a single orange (every ginkgo marker is `orange`)
- Trees with fall colour: red to purple
- Other deciduous trees (less known for fall colour): brown to near-black

## Data

Tree records come from each municipality's open data portal and stay under that
publisher's terms; see /DATA_LICENSES.md. Species annotations are AI-assisted and
are not a botanical authority. Basemap © OpenStreetMap contributors.
